title: A package-manager choice restated in three sessions becomes standing and reaches a fourth, unrelated session

turns.user: In the webshop repo we use pnpm, not npm.

agent_captures.quote: In the webshop repo we use pnpm

turns.agent_reply: Noted: the webshop repo uses pnpm. I'll use pnpm for installs there.
Ran pnpm add zod. package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml are updated.

turns.user: Acordate que en webshop usamos pnpm.
turns.agent_reply: Sí, lo tengo: en webshop se usa pnpm. Todo lo que instale va con pnpm.
Listo: corrí pnpm add date-fns. El lockfile quedó actualizado.

turns.user: Again, webshop uses pnpm: someone ran npm install yesterday and broke the lockfile.
turns.agent_reply: Got it. I can restore pnpm-lock.yaml from main and delete the package-lock.json that npm created.
Done: pnpm-lock.yaml is restored from main and package-lock.json is gone. pnpm install --frozen-lockfile passes.

turns.user: ¿Cómo configuro Prettier para que ordene los imports?
turns.agent_reply: Instalá el plugin con pnpm add -D @trivago/prettier-plugin-sort-imports y agregalo en .prettierrc junto con un importOrder. Después corré pnpm prettier --write . para aplicarlo a todo el repo.
De nada. Si querés, agrego el formateo al hook de pre-commit.
